environment: Production Swing panel with a Montoya test adapter and two actual isolated loopback HTTP responses; NOT native Burp GUI

load.description: Repeated original-linked synthetic observations, not distinct endpoint discovery or vulnerability findings

measurementBoundary: EDT action only: accept(snapshot) or sort-only; fixture construction, preparation, initial sort, validation and invokeAndWait waiting are excluded
allocationMeaning: ThreadMXBean allocated bytes on EDT during the action; not retained heap, process RSS, background allocations or peak memory
summaryRule: Two warmups are recorded separately and excluded from five-sample median/min/max; no timing pass/fail threshold
